note: the preview store evicts the newest read first instead of the least recently read, caught by evictsLeastRecentlyRead
a preview read doesn't bump its recency, caught by readBumpsRecency
the preview temp file is the target itself, so it is renamed before it is complete and readers see part-written bytes, caught by interruptedWriteKeepsOld
the preview budget evicts at exactly the budget instead of only over it, caught by evictsLeastRecentlyRead
the preview folder lock is shared instead of exclusive, so two stores lose entries, caught by twoStoresUnderTheLockLoseNothing
